observations: The target-freezing case now passes and proves the delayed DrawUpToEffect stores EffectTarget.SpecificEntity(victim) before the countered spell leaves the stack.
The uncounterable-target case passes and still schedules Arcane Denial's two independent delayed draw abilities.

The next-upkeep case fails only because the fixture expects ChooseNumberDecision immediately while the engine first presents the existing simultaneous-trigger ChooseOptionDecision required to order Arcane Denial's two delayed triggers.

diagnosis.evidence: ArcaneDenialScenarioTest.kt:95 reports no draw-up-to decision after entering upkeep; TriggerProcessor.presentTriggerOrdering requires the common controller to order multiple simultaneous triggers and explicitly says first chosen resolves last.
diagnosis.mechanics_interpretation: No additional target-binding engine defect is established by this failure. The repaired scheduling-time target freeze is directly validated by the first passing case.

successor: Change only the Arcane Denial scenario fixture so the next-upkeep case answers the engine-required ChooseOptionDecision for the two simultaneous delayed triggers before resolving toward ChooseNumberDecision; preserve the card definitions and target-freezing engine repair, re-pin exact changed test/workflow bytes, and rerun the same semantic cases.
